description: Pull free-to-play games into a workflow from FreeToGame, the Free-To-Play Games Database: hundreds of free PC and browser games with their genre, studio, release date, description, screenshots and minimum system requirements. Search the catalogue by name or by what a game is - FreeToGame has no search of its own - combine tags to find exactly the kind of game you want, pick a free game of the day, find games like one you already have, and check what a machine needs to run one. No account or API key is required.
